title: config/commands.yaml
description: The commands of `bl` (commands.md, D-421 to D-424; F-138 D2). A map from a command name to its line. Each line runs an op (an operation in `bl`'s code) or a flow entry, and gives the options of `argparse`'s `add_parser` by their own names. `args` go before the caller's arguments, as a git alias does. Only the shop's file counts: no layer patches it (D-422).

op.description: The op that the command runs.

entry.description: The flow entry that the command runs.

description.description: The text at the top of `bl <name> --help`.

args.description: Arguments that go before the caller's arguments.
